text:
Rafael Mendes: putting a proposal here for dashboards + alerts for the marketplace purchase->provisioning path (AWS + GCP). we’ve had a couple of “it’s stuck” reports in staging and I don’t want to go into launch without a clear view + paging thresholds.

Rafael Mendes: dashboards I think we need (Grafana):
1) Webhook ingestion health
- `marketplace_webhook_requests_total{provider}` by status (2xx/4xx/5xx)
- `marketplace_webhook_validation_failures_total{provider,reason}`
- `marketplace_webhook_processing_latency_seconds{provider}` p50/p95/p99
- DLQ depth (if we’re using it) + reprocess rate

2) Entitlement lag
- time from provider event -> entitlement active in Redwood: `marketplace_entitlement_activation_lag_seconds{provider,sku}` p50/p95
- count of entitlements “pending” > X minutes

3) Provisioning outcomes
- end-to-end activation funnel: webhook received -> entitlement mapped -> org linked -> usable
- error rate: `marketplace_provisioning_errors_total{provider,stage,code}`

Rafael Mendes: alerts (PagerDuty) proposal:
A) Webhook failures
- rate of 5xx > 1% for 10m OR > 5/min for 5m (provider-specific)
- validation failures spike: > 20/min for 10m (usually schema change or signature mismatch)

B) Entitlement lag
- p95 lag > 15 min for 10m (warn)
- p95 lag > 30 min for 10m (page)

C) Provisioning error rate
- `provisioning_errors / provisioning_attempts` > 2% for 15m (warn) > 5% for 10m (page)

Rafael Mendes: would love feedback on: thresholds, missing signals, and whether to split AWS vs GCP dashboards.

Allison Grant: :eyes: +1. we should also track idempotency / duplicates. if we see a loop it’ll inflate counts and hide real failures.

Allison Grant: metrics to add:
- `marketplace_webhook_deduped_total{provider}`
- `marketplace_webhook_idempotency_conflicts_total{provider}` (if we treat as noop vs error)

Allison Grant: for the dashboard, a “top reasons” table for validation failures helps (signature, timestamp skew, missing entitlement id, etc).

Ethan Park: agree on all. one nuance: entitlement “lag” is actually 2 parts for us:
1) provider event -> we persist raw event
2) raw event -> mapping job -> entitlement active

Ethan Park: if we only alert on end-to-end lag we won’t know if it’s webhook intake vs mapper vs downstream billing call.

Ethan Park: suggest we add timers:
- `marketplace_event_persist_lag_seconds{provider}`
- `marketplace_entitlement_mapping_lag_seconds{provider}`
- `marketplace_entitlement_activation_lag_seconds{provider}` (overall)

Nadia Rahman: for provisioning outcomes: can we also break down “entitlement active but no usage” ? sales/support keep asking “did they actually start sending tokens”.

Nadia Rahman: not for paging, but a panel like “activated entitlements w/ 0 requests after 24h” by provider/SKU would help CS.

Rafael Mendes: good call. we can pull from `inference_requests_total{billing_source="marketplace"}` maybe.

Cole Summers: on thresholds: 2% provisioning errors might be noisy if volume is low. we may want absolute + relative.

Cole Summers: e.g. warn if `>5 errors in 15m AND error_rate > 2%`. page if `>10 errors in 10m AND error_rate > 5%`. otherwise a single bad customer edge case will page.

Allison Grant: +1 to absolute gate.

Leila Farouk: QA angle: for canary rollout we’ll want a panel that compares “control vs canary” if we flag the new flow.

Leila Farouk: do we have labels for `flow_version` or `feature_flag`? if not, please add before launch or we can’t validate.

Ethan Park: we have `onboarding_flow_version` in the logs but not in metrics. we can add it to `marketplace_provisioning_attempts_total{provider,flow_version}` and errors too.

MarketplaceBot: Reminder: Marketplace onboarding launch readiness checklist item “Monitoring & alerting defined (ENG-4407)” is due in 3 days. Owner: Rafael Mendes.

Rafael Mendes: lol thanks bot.

Rafael Mendes: action items I’m hearing:
- add stage-specific lag metrics (Ethan)
- add dedupe/idempotency counters (Allison)
- add absolute+relative gates for alerts (Cole)
- add `flow_version` dimension for canary validation (Leila)
- add “activated but no usage after 24h” panel (Nadia) (non-paging)

Rafael Mendes: Allison can you sanity-check alert routing? I’d propose:
- webhook 5xx / validation spikes -> SRE primary
- mapping lag (stage 2) -> control plane oncall + SRE secondary
- billing/metering failures -> billing oncall + SRE secondary

Allison Grant: routing looks right. make sure alerts include provider + SKU + top reason + link to runbook + logs query.

Allison Grant: also: add a “no webhooks received” deadman alert (esp for GCP) — if requests_total drops to 0 during business hours but we expect traffic, it can be an integration break.

Rafael Mendes: good idea. maybe scoped to production only and only once we have baseline. we can start as warning.

Cole Summers: +1. for “no webhooks received”, careful w/ weekends. maybe do a 4h window and only page if there were activations in last 7d.

Ethan Park: I’ll add the stage metrics + flow_version labels today/tomorrow. will ping when in staging.

Rafael Mendes: cool. I’ll draft the Grafana dashboard + alert rules and post screenshots here for review before we wire to PD.
